title: LayoutStack
description: Generic layout container that stacks its children along a single axis. It carries no business data: its AG-UI state is empty. Layout is a presentation concern and travels as an A2-UI node prop ('direction': 'column' | 'row'), never as AG-UI state. Reused across surfaces (commerce search, knowledge search) to compose columns and rows from the A2-UI composition plane rather than hardcoding layout per parent renderer.

LayoutStackState.title: LayoutStackState
LayoutStackState.description: The layout-stack state. A layout container holds no business data, so its state is always the empty object. The stacking direction is presentation and travels as an A2-UI node prop, never as AG-UI state.
